title: 第21章粮价暴跌心里博弈第22章返回长安风暴即将来临之际
slug: 我最强毒士女帝直呼活阎王
lines: “启禀大人，临江城粮价已低至九十文一斗！”
“启禀大人，临江城粮价已低至八十六文一斗！”
“启禀大人，临江城粮价已低至八十文一斗！”
“临江城粮价已低至七十五文一斗！”
县衙内，高阳正抿着茶。
一个接一个的衙役冲了进来，他们跪在地上，满脸激动，几乎是用自已最大的声音喊了出来。
当一道道声音响彻整个府衙大堂的时候，整个临江县衙内的衙役全都满脸不可思议。
紧接着，他们的目光骤然看向了县衙中间满脸淡然的高阳。
他们费劲手段，都未能降下去的粮价，竟在高阳的手上一日暴跌！
别说今日从两百多文开始的暴跌，哪怕是七日之前一百文一斗的高价，也足足跌了二十五文！
七十五文一斗，将极大的缓解临江城百姓的压力。
杜江更是不可置信。
虽然高阳说完后，他就预感到四大粮商会产生分歧，但没想到居然这么快。
这才短短数个时辰，便开始了抛售！
高阳抿了一口茶，开口道，“这茶不错。”
杜江很懂事的道，“待到大人返回长安时，下官将此茶给大人备上一些。”
“当然，下官自掏腰包，只是人情往来。”
杜江说话间看了一眼上官婉儿。
上官婉儿表情不变，这等事情，哪怕杜江不特地解释，她也权当没看到。
水至清则无鱼。
官场有点人情往来很正常，更别说杜江送的只是一点不值钱的茶叶。
“茶就不必了，折现吧，本官最不喜欢这些俗物，当直接点。”
高阳放下茶杯，看向杜江。
上官婉儿：“……”
“高御史！”
上官婉儿声音拔高，提醒了一句。
当着她上官婉儿的面，这未免太猖獗了点。
哪怕是暗地里说，她都权当不知道。
“咳咳。”
“上官大人你瞧你，未免太紧张了一些，本公子像那种人吗？不过是开个玩笑罢了！”
高阳赶忙开口道。
content_en:
"Report!"
"Sir, the price of food in Linjiang City has dropped to ninety cents per dou!"
"Report!"
"Sir, the price of food in Linjiang City has dropped to eighty-six cents per dou!"
"Report!"
"Sir, the price of food in Linjiang City has dropped to eighty cents per dou!"
"Report!"
"The price of food in Linjiang City has been as low as seventy-five cents per dou!"
In the county government office, Gao Yang was sipping tea.
One after another, the government officials rushed in. They knelt on the ground, their faces full of excitement, and they almost shouted at the top of their lungs.
When the sounds echoed through the entire government office lobby, all the government officials in Linjiang County had expressions of disbelief.
Immediately afterwards, their eyes suddenly turned to Gao Yang, who was in the middle of the county government office with an indifferent expression.
The price of food, which they had tried so hard to reduce, actually plummeted in one day at the hands of Gao Yang!
Not to mention the sharp drop from more than two hundred cents today, even the high price of one hundred cents per dou seven days ago has dropped by a full twenty-five cents!
Seventy-five cents a fight will greatly relieve the pressure on the people of Linjiang City.
Du Jiang was even more unbelievable.
Although after Gao Yang finished speaking, he had a premonition that the four major grain merchants would disagree, but he did not expect it to happen so quickly.
Only a few hours later, the selling started!
Gao Yang took a sip of tea and said, "This tea is good."
Du Jiang said very sensibly, "When your Excellency returns to Chang'an, I will prepare some of this tea for you."
"Of course, the official paid for it out of his own pocket. It's just a favor."
Du Jiang glanced at Shangguan Wan'er while speaking.
Shangguan Wan'er's expression remained unchanged. Even if Du Jiang didn't explain it specifically, she would have pretended not to have seen it.
If the water is clear, there will be no fish.
It is normal for some favors to be exchanged in official circles, not to mention that what Du Jiang sent was just some worthless tea.
"There's no need for tea. Just give it a discount. I don't like these vulgar things the most, so just order it directly."
Gao Yang put down his tea cup and looked at Du Jiang.
Shangguan Wan'er: "..."
Du Jiang: "..."
"Gao Yushi!"
Shangguan Wan'er raised her voice and warned.
In front of her Shangguan Wan'er, this was a bit too outrageous.
Even if she said it secretly, she had the right to pretend that she didn't know.
"Ahem."
"Sir Shangguan, look at you, you are a little too nervous. Do I look like that kind of person? It's just a joke!"
Gao Yang said quickly.
title_en: Chapter 21: The sudden drop in food prices and the psychological game Chapter 22: Return to Chang'an when the storm is coming
